reviews.title: Good air flow but short fan and rgb cables
reviews.comment: Good included fans and airflow.  Cables for audio, fans, and rgb are too short to stay in the cable management Chanel so thwart cable management.  Getting  Accessory box out is a Chinese puzzle.  It’s behind the case, but instructions for opening case are in the box.  And the box is crammed into disk slot so hard that I had to rip box apart to get it out.  Kind of like buying a safe with the keys locked inside.
reviews.author: Kindle Customer

reviews.comment: Nice large inside.  Super cute. Holds all my build.  Solid material.

reviews.title: Awesome case. Inflated price
reviews.comment: The case is amazing. The price however, is $50 more than regular MSRP. So it’s up to you if you want to pay an extra $50 for the availability since it was sold out everywhere else when I purchased mine.
